description:
Cast Release to the Wind by paying {2}{U}, exiling Barren Glory with the ability to cast it from exile.
Cast Kaervek's Spite by paying {B}{B}{B}, discarding your hand, and sacrificing all permanents, causing target player to lose 5 life.
Cast Barren Glory from exile without paying its mana cost.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
